title: smol brains
pitch: an island of tiny pixel creatures with real neural-network brains. they crash-land, evolve, invent fire, build villages and pray to you. they will learn the wrong things.
controls: drag to pan, pinch or wheel to zoom, twist or right-drag to rotate, slide two fingers (or r/v) to tilt, tap or drag the map to jump. tools: grab (carry, throw, shake trees), tickle (reward), tap (scold), talk (the word book), magic (miracles), orders. possess a smol from its card: wasd + mouse, left click uses what you hold, right click places or eats, f picks up, q drops, e does what the prompt says, g sniffs for food (blobs and critters), 1-9 or the wheel pick a hotbar slot, tab opens the bag and crafting, b the building plans, r turns a building, esc or backspace leaves (phones: thumbstick, look pad, an action button that says what it does). wasd pan, q/e rotate, 1-6 tools, space pause, [ ] speed, b brain viewer (of the picked smol, or the nearest), backspace closes windows, m map.
how_to: ▶ play now drops you on a fresh island in one tap. 🌱 custom island lets you pick a name, a size (small to extra large) and how wild it is. load keeps every island you've made.
tap the crashed pod open. two blobs climb out, a girl and a boy: the last smols. name them.

🎓 tricks: tap a smol, then 🎓 tricks. every bar is read live from its brain. press “set it up”, wait for “tickle now!”, then 🪶 tickle (or 👆 tap) right then: each good lesson fills a third of the bar. three and it has learned the trick, which pays ✨ sparks. a click at the wrong moment is held back.
the chapter list (top left) always has a few quests with ✨ rewards. tap one to see how. your first 👁 possession is free.

💬 talk opens the word book. pick a word, then show it: tap some food for “food”, or ask a smol to “come” and it learns when it does. one lesson every 4 seconds, faster with a friend nearby who knows it, so mashing does nothing.
tickle right after the good thing. a few seconds late rewards whatever it is doing by then, which is how smols learn weird superstitions.
smols remember who hit them, shared food, or taught them things. tap a smol → 📜 story to see its friends, rivals and life so far; the menu's 📜 chronicle keeps the island's history.
family can't have kids together. welcome strangers from the other escape pods, or your tribe runs out of futures.
miracles get pricier the more you lean on them, and handouts spoil smols. answer prayers with the right miracle: that's where sparks come from.
the island starts under cloud. smols clear it by exploring, and new places hold new plants, stone, and bunnies to hunt.
a storyteller deals story cards every few minutes: grump raids, storms, sniffles, falling stars, feuds, lost kids, dreams. pick an answer; some cost ✨ sparks.
explore the fog: the "?" marks hide ruins, crystal caves, nests and grump camps holding captured smols.
tap a smol and it holds still for a few seconds, so it's easy to teach. the word book opens at the side of the screen.

the seasons turn every 40 minutes: blossoms, summer storms, falling leaves, snow. the soundtrack, 20 songs, follows them; some only play in one season, at night, or in the rain. settings has a jukebox.
more escape pods crash while you play. you see where on the map: send a rescue party of grown smols, lift them home with magic, or they climb out on their own later.
smols remember places, dream about their day, read each other's moods and pick goals. open the 🧠 brain viewer to hear what one is thinking.
the tutorial starts by itself and stays with you the whole game, with a tip whenever something new happens or you're not sure what to do. “skip tutorial” is always on its card.

after the tutorial, 🚩 orders put up a rally flag (go there) and home and no-go zones, even for blobs. tool-users add work marks, blueprints and a stockpile. smols follow if they trust you, and get grumpy if you boss them.
🧪 a sandbox island (create world → mode) has a spawn palette in ✨ magic and free miracles. 📌 keep a copy (menu → settings) is a save slot you can come back to.

possess a smol (smol card, 3 sparks) to live as it: a hotbar and a bag, hearts and drumsticks, a rock-on-a-stick to make, trees to chop, a campfire and a lean-to to build. a first-time guide walks you through it. its brain learns from how you play it. even a blob has a day to live: carry a mouthful, tug leaves, line the nest (eggs hatch faster), press G to sniff out food, and share with a friend.
every smol rolls traits and a rarity, common to mythic. rare parents make rare babies; the smoldex keeps your best.
evolve them all the way to ascended and build the big thought. it's a signal home. then try new game+.
your band grows into a village, a town and a city: money, market stalls, jobs, roads, a council and city lights. the 🏛 civilization tab shows what the next era needs.
it isn't safe. grumps raid, steal, burn huts and carry smols off to their camps; the village fights back and rebuilds. rare disasters depend on where you live.
settings → look has a new ✨ hd pixel look: drawn pixel-art tiles and items, warm light and soft focus. from tribe on, smols grow up and their faces show how they really feel.
love takes time now: grown-up smols court one partner, hearts are for partners and their kids, and a full village has no eggs until builders put up more huts.
